meta.name: debug
meta.description: Debug container agent issues. Use when things aren't working, container fails, authentication problems, or to understand how the container system works. Covers logs, session DBs, mounts, and common issues.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 排查容器和 agent 运行问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到容器或 agent 运行异常需要定位根因
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to diagnose container or agent runtime problems

howto.what: 当容器化 agent 出问题时,Claude 会按这份指南排查:查看主机与会话日志、用查询脚本读取 inbound.db 和 outbound.db、核对挂载点,再给出对应的修复步骤。
howto.when: 当运行出问题、容器启动失败、出现认证错误,或你想了解容器系统如何工作时触发。

say.text: 机器人不回复了,帮我查下日志和会话数据库
容器刚启动就退出,帮我排查原因
say.note: 会检查密钥模式和 OneCLI 网关是否可达

say.text: 帮我看下 /workspace 的挂载对不对
say.note: 用 debug 日志核对挂载目标

howto.what_en: When the container agent misbehaves, Claude follows this guide: checks host and session logs, queries inbound.db and outbound.db, verifies mount targets, and applies the matching fix.
howto.when_en: Triggers when things aren't working, a container fails, authentication errors appear, or you want to understand how the container system works.

say_en.text: The bot stopped replying — check the logs and session DBs
The container exits right after spawning; help me find why
say_en.note: Checks secret mode and whether the gateway is reachable

say_en.text: Check whether the /workspace mounts are correct
say_en.note: Compares mount targets using debug logs
